title: Consistency Thresholds for Causal Mutual Information with Two Growing Alphabets
banked_reason: D0.5.G cold referee: delivered tier=incremental < floor=field (target=field), paper_score_ceiling 6.4 < 7.4, not salvageable within scope.
gap_reasons: The delivered result settles normalized-information consistency and shrinking honest length, but supplies neither matched precision rates nor a quantitative propensity-learning price at the critical joint scale d≈k²≈n.

The arithmetic certification is analytical, with no delivered implementation or numerical resolution study showing when the conservative honest intervals become informative; this limits the practical significance supporting a leading-econometrics paper.
D0.5.G projected paper-score gate: paper_score_ceiling 6.4 < 7.4, so the graded tier 'field' is capped at 'incremental'.
proof_attempt_summary: The run derived the normalized interventional-information consistency boundary, conservative computable risk and honest-length envelopes, and original-law all-procedure obstructions. D0.5 passed the mathematics and five independently verified cited-source statements, but graded the delivered research package incremental below the field floor (score ceiling 6.4 versus 7.4). Matched precision rates and a quantitative propensity-learning price remain in sharp-precision-extension; formalization was not launched.
tldr: Same-world causal dependence is identified by discrete adjustment, but its estimability depends on two growing alphabets. The target is mutual information of the standardized treated joint table divided by \(\log k\). The theorem characterizes vanishing minimax absolute risk and vanishing expected length of finite-sample honest connected intervals exactly by \(D(n,d_n)\to0\) and \(K(n,k_n)\to0\). Revealing the propensity vector on identical records removes precisely the adjustment condition. The upper argument controls a growing Shannon matrix with positive learned common weights, arbitrary zero support and random normalization. The converse uses lawful full-record propensity priors and coherent direct-information experiments. Total rational finite-input procedures and their outward risk envelopes are certified; matched precision rates remain the separate extension.
gap: Zeng et al. Theorem 5 isolates a scalar obstruction under a known uniform covariate law. Han--Jiao--Weissman Theorem 2 analyzes directly sampled entropy in undersampled regimes. The learned-weight standardized information matrix and its honest-inference boundary are not covered by either result.
fill: The kernel joins a complete shared-covariance Shannon upper bound to original-law obstructions, a finite whole-class honest construction and an identical-record propensity comparison. The phase theorem covers every alphabet sequence and permits zero cells. Its finite bounds are conservative.
